tips.title: Akiru ebuni
body: **Akiru** is rain: **Akiru ebuni** (rain is coming). **Akolong** is sun and also daytime. **Elilim** is cold.

tips.title: Akamu and apak lo akiru
body: **Akamu** is the dry season, **apak lo akiru** the rainy season (literally “time of rain”). **Apak** means time or weather.

culture.title: Two rainy seasons
body: Teso has two rainy seasons, March to May and August to November, and a long dry season when the grass burns and the wind blows dust.
